Bullish Scenario Gold can only regain upward momentum if buyers reclaim 4360–4370 with a decisive H4 close. A confirmed breakout could bring price back toward 4425–4440, where major supply remains. Until that happens, chasing buys carries unfavorable risk after the previous rejection. Lucas View The broader momentum is shifting from expansion to distribution/correction.
